name: Tennis coaching
summary: How expats find tennis coaches and clinics in Singapore — condo courts vs clubs, junior pathways, humid-climate scheduling, and trial norms before multi-month packages.
body:
Tennis here runs on condo courts, public ActiveSG centres, and private clubs. Coaches range from recreational hitters to junior-performance programmes. Humidity and evening thunderstorms shape scheduling as much as price.

## Formats
- Private hourly lessons (adult technique or cardio tennis)
- Semi-private / group clinics
- Junior group pathways with match play
- Cardio tennis and beginner adult intakes after landing

Club membership may be required for certain courts; condo rules can limit guest coaches — check MCST norms before booking.

## Choosing a coach
Watch a session: feedback quality, safety spacing, and whether they film or only feed balls. Ask about rain make-ups, court booking responsibility, and ball costs. For juniors, clarify competition pressure vs fun clinics. UTR/tournament talk should match the child’s age and school load.

## How to choose
Trial before packages. Prefer coaches who adapt to heat (hydration breaks, shorter mid-day blocks) and who will say when physio/sports medicine is needed for elbow or shoulder niggles. Racket stringing and grip advice in humid weather matters more than logo apparel.

## Practical tip
Book covered or early-morning slots in monsoon months. Bring electrolytes; “just water” fades fast on outdoor hard courts after 10am.
